method.controls: Keep clean speech, mixtures with no added tone, room-only excerpts, level and timing changes, ordinary local speech-only shifts, low-pass filtering and smoothly varying tone timing.
method.inputs: First 24 distinct LibriSpeech speakers with a usable native 16 kHz take in the two pinned shards. Use different recorded tone sources and noise excerpts. Score all frozen clips.
method.outcome: Count useful positions, missed events, wrong locations and ordinary flags. A localized tone change has zero authorship weight.
method.point: Use the original broader point for each rule. The persistent variant applies the same single-tone point. Require at least eight complete 40 ms frame centers on each outer side and support in at least 60 percent.
